scope: Cached publication, fallback, local rollback floor, retained signed evidence, measurement boundaries and adversarial tests

resolved.finding: Unbounded typed tail could delay candidate fallback
resolved.resolution: Preflight step-count and serialized-byte budgets; separate regression tests and mutations

resolved.finding: FIFO or special cache file could block before fallback
resolved.resolution: Unix nonblocking no-follow open and regular-file check; canonical-hash symlink regression and mutation

resolved.finding: Warm retention test resupplied evidence and could mask evidence loss
resolved.resolution: Regression retains a superseded signed body without resupplying it

resolved.finding: Timing included rendering and oracle assertions
resolved.resolution: Stop timer immediately after load and explicitly exclude typed-tail decoding and offer preparation
Concurrent branch floor test requires both branches and accepts authenticated missing-branch catchup

resolved.finding: Accepted history could be reused across dialect context
resolved.resolution: Member and Client pin context; regression uses same native root identity with changed dialect context

assessment: No correctness blocker in reviewer follow-up before the final two isolated test-strengthening changes. Results support further publication-cadence and incremental-publication experiments; no global freshness or constant-frontier claim.
final_followup: Reviewer confirmed both final test gaps closed and 47 tests passing, with no further findings. Agent subsequently verified all eight mutation result entries are test kills after successful disk-cleanup rerun.
